payload.name: Courtroom5
payload.description: 覆盖 50 个州的民事法律帮助
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Courtroom5 serves self-represented litigants (SRLs) — people who must navigate civil court without an attorney, typically because they cannot afford one. Roughly 80% of civil litigants in the United States appear without legal representation. Without guidance, they lose cases on procedural technicalities before the merits are ever heard.

The Courtroom5 app gives ChatGPT users access to three jurisdiction-aware legal tools: a case intake assessment that evaluates a user's situation and identifies applicable civil claims; a deadline calculator that returns precise procedural deadlines and consequences by state and court level; and next-step guidance for users already in active litigation. All tools are scoped to civil matters in US state and federal courts and designed for plain-language delivery to non-lawyers.

Courtroom5 is a Techstars graduate and recipient of the ABA Woman of Legal Tech recognition. We have served over 12,000 self-represented litigants across all 50 states.
payload.longDescription:
Courtroom5 服务于自行代理的诉讼当事人（SRL）——他们通常因无力承担律师费用而不得不在没有律师的情况下应对民事诉讼。美国大约 80% 的民事诉讼当事人没有法律代理。缺乏指导时，他们往往在案件实体问题得到审理前，就因程序性细节而败诉。

Courtroom5 应用为 ChatGPT 用户提供三种了解司法管辖区的法律工具：评估用户情况并识别适用民事诉求的案件受理评估；按州和法院级别提供精确程序期限及其后果的截止日期计算器；以及为已进入诉讼程序的用户提供后续步骤指导。所有工具仅适用于美国州法院和联邦法院的民事案件，并以通俗易懂的语言面向非律师设计。

Courtroom5 是 Techstars 毕业企业，并获得 ABA Woman of Legal Tech 认可。我们已在全部 50 个州为超过 12,000 名自行代理的诉讼当事人提供服务。

Ready to plan your week? Ask for a meal plan and get a personalized 3–7 day schedule built around ingredient overlap to minimize waste and simplify shopping — complete with an auto-generated shopping list you can print and take to the store.

payload.longDescription:
按食材、菜系或口味偏好查找食谱，浏览精心挑选的匹配食谱和合集轮播，其中包含照片、评分和摘录。打开任意食谱，可查看详情、特色食材以及完整做法的直接链接。

无论你想知道一大把柠檬能做什么，还是计划一整周的健康晚餐，Love & Lemons 都能让这件事变得轻松又美味。

payload.name: Loft
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Loft app helps you find the ideal property in a simple, fast, and smart way.
Here, you can search for properties available for purchase or rent, compare options, understand market prices, and make decisions with greater confidence.

In addition to search, the app offers insights that make your choice easier, such as value estimates, property features, and comparisons across different regions.
Everything is designed for those who want to avoid hassle and save time when choosing a place to live or invest.

Whether you’re looking for your next home or a great investment opportunity, Loft provides clear information and technology to support your decision.
payload.longDescription:
Loft 应用以简单、快速、智能的方式帮助你找到理想房产。
你可以搜索待售或出租房产、比较选项、了解市场价格，并更有信心地做决定。

除搜索之外，应用还提供让选择更轻松的洞察，例如价值估算、房产特征和不同地区之间的比较。所有设计都面向希望在选择居住或投资地点时避免麻烦、节省时间的人。

无论你寻找下一套住宅还是绝佳投资机会，Loft 都会提供清晰信息和技术支持你的决策。

payload.name: Astrologer Jyai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jyai is a free AI Astrology application available on the ChatGPT Store. Since 2023, we have been providing free AI astrology services and continue to help users explore astrological insights through intelligent, conversational guidance.
payload.longDescription: Jyai 是 ChatGPT Store 上的免费 AI 占星应用。自 2023 年以来，我们一直提供免费 AI 占星服务，并持续通过智能对话式指导，帮助用户探索占星洞察。

payload.name: ClickDealer
payload.summaryOriginal: Search used cars in the UK
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find the car that fits your life, not just your search.
 
Powered by Click Dealer, the trusted technology behind thousands of UK dealer websites, the app connects you directly with reputable dealers, giving you a more confident way to find your next car. 
 
No endless scrolling. No guesswork. Just personalised recommendations, real-time vehicle listings and cars matched to what you’re comfortable spending.
payload.longDescription:
找到适合你生活的车，而不只是符合搜索条件的车。

这款应用由 Click Dealer 提供支持；Click Dealer 是数千家英国经销商网站背后的可信技术平台。它将你直接连接到信誉良好的经销商，让你更安心地寻找下一辆车。

无需无休止地浏览，也不必猜测。你将获得个性化推荐、实时车辆列表，以及符合你预算承受能力的汽车。

payload.name: Shipal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Shipal helps users track parcels by tracking number. It automatically identifies the carrier and shows the current shipment status, latest event, city-level location, time in transit, delivery estimate when available, and a chronological tracking history.
payload.longDescription: Shipal 可帮助用户通过追踪号码查询包裹。它会自动识别承运商，并显示当前运输状态、最新动态、城市级位置、在途时间、可用时的预计送达时间，以及按时间顺序排列的追踪记录。

payload.name: RealAI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The RealAI MCP provides ChatGPT access to RealAI’s authoritative real estate data catalog, spanning 126 million US properties (including 230,000 multifamily communities with unit-level operating detail), aggregated data on the 250 million people who live in them, their rent and leasing activity, and market/geographic data from the metro down to the census-block level.

RealAI doesn't just describe properties and places — it scores and ranks them. Every area and building carries normalized national and local benchmarks across hundreds of attributes, so RealAI can rank an entire population — markets, neighborhoods, or buildings — against any combination of criteria a user cares about, rather than profiling one place at a time off a fixed template.

Two examples of data depth most tools can't match: migration data that captures not just population flows but the age, income, wealth, and education profile of who is moving in versus out of a market; and unit-level rent-roll history built from nightly listings nationwide — asking vs. in-place rents, occupancy, days on market, rent growth, turnover, and tradeouts.

payload.name: Avito.ma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cars, real estate, smartphones, multimedia, home, fashion, leisure, bikes, DIY... now access Avito.ma listings directly from ChatGPT.

汽车、房地产、智能手机、多媒体、家居、时尚、休闲、自行车、DIY……现在可以直接从 ChatGPT 访问 Avito.ma 刊登信息。

payload.name: Spee24 Shopping
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Spee24 Shopping is your AI-powered smart shopping companion. Find thousands of products from Spee24 Shop, compare prices, uncover the best deals, and get tailored recommendations instantly. Shop confidently with AI that finds the right product, every time.

payload.name: ShopBack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

payload.longDescription:
ShopBack 可帮助你在购物时发现返现优惠。

搜索品牌或类别，即可查看可用的返现优惠。

payload.name: coches.net
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access the coches.net marketplace to search for new, used, and classic cars. This app allows you to filter listings by make, model, price, year, and location. Users can retrieve current car listings, view technical details, and compare different vehicle options directly through chat.
payload.longDescription: 访问 coches.net 市场，搜索新车、二手车和经典车。按品牌、车型、价格、年份和地点筛选车源。用户可以直接在聊天中获取当前车源、查看技术详情并比较不同车辆选项。

payload.name: Deglaze
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Deglaze brings your recipe library into ChatGPT, turning it into a cooking assistant that starts from what you and your household actually cook. It connects your Deglaze account — saved recipes (from websites, social media, cookbooks, etc.), meal plan, grocery list, household food preferences, and cooking history — so recipe suggestions reflect your real tastes and constraints.

Ask for dinner ideas and get recipes from your own library, or branch out with new recipes from Deglaze's discovery database and save the keepers to your library. Browse results as recipe cards with photos, tap through to the full recipe, or create a new recipe in the conversation from family favorites, ingredients you mention, or an idea ChatGPT helps develop.

Then turn ideas into action: put recipes on your meal plan, add their ingredients to your grocery list while skipping items you tell it to omit, and manage the list as you shop. Deglaze uses your preferences and cooking history to steer around allergies, lean into the flavors your household likes, and suggest meals without repeating recent dinners.
payload.longDescription:
Deglaze 将你的食谱库带入 ChatGPT，把它变成一位从你和家人实际烹饪习惯出发的烹饪助手。它连接你的 Deglaze 账户，包括已保存的食谱（来自网站、社交媒体、食谱书等）、膳食计划、购物清单、家庭饮食偏好和烹饪历史，让食谱建议符合你的真实口味和限制。

询问晚餐灵感，即可从自己的食谱库获取食谱；也可以从 Deglaze 的发现数据库探索新食谱，并将喜欢的保存到食谱库。浏览带照片的食谱卡片，点击查看完整食谱，或在对话中根据家庭喜爱的菜肴、你提到的食材或 ChatGPT 帮助完善的点子创建新食谱。

接着将想法付诸行动：把食谱加入膳食计划，将食材加入购物清单（跳过你要求排除的物品），并在购物时管理清单。Deglaze 会根据你的偏好和烹饪历史避开过敏原、优先考虑家人喜欢的口味，并避免重复推荐近期吃过的晚餐。

payload.name: onX Offroad
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find your next off-road adventure. Search trails near any location in the US, Canada, or Mexico and filter by technical difficulty, vehicle type, trail length, and season. View detailed trail cards with detailed trail info, trail reports, photos, elevation profiles, difficulty ratings, vehicle compatibility, and more. All powered by onX Offroad.
payload.longDescription: 寻找下一次越野探险。在美国、加拿大或墨西哥的任意地点附近搜索路线，并按技术难度、车辆类型、路线长度和季节筛选。查看详细路线卡片，包含路线信息、路线报告、照片、海拔剖面、难度评级、车辆适配性等内容。所有信息均由 onX Offroad 提供。

payload.name: Bandsintown
payload.description: 查找演唱会和巡演日期
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bandsintown provides real-time concert and tour information so you can easily find live music by artist, location, or date.

Use Bandsintown to:
Find concerts and live music near you tonight, this weekend, or on any date
Check if your favorite artists are touring and where they’re playing
Find shows by location, venue, or genre
Get tour dates and event details, including links to tickets from official ticket sellers

- 查询停车位、室内洗衣设备或允许宠物的公寓等必需条件
- 查看当前空置情况和户型选择

试着这样开始：

连接 RentCafe，让搜索更快捷、更灵活。

payload.name: Housing.com

From ready-to-move apartments and new launches to rental homes, finding the right place to live is now effortless with the Housing.com  ChatGPT app.

payload.name: Guanyin Oracle · 观音灵签
payload.description: 以中文为主的灵签仪式
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Guanyin Oracle offers a quiet, Chinese-first reflection ritual based on a bundled 100-sign Guanyin corpus. Hold one focused question, make one symbolic draw, then confirm it with one symbolic cup action. The source sign poem and traditional note remain in Chinese, with a detailed interpretation in Chinese and faithful English.

Each reading connects the sign to the question, distinguishes reflection from prediction, and offers practical seven-day actions and clear boundaries for health, financial, legal, and other consequential topics. Users may optionally save a JPEG card for the exact sign they drew. The service processes only inputs needed to return the reading and does not persist ritual sessions.
payload.longDescription:
Guanyin Oracle 提供宁静的中文优先反思仪式，基于内置的观音 100 签内容。专注于一个问题，象征性地抽取一签，再以一次象征性的掷杯动作确认。原始签诗和传统注解保留中文，并提供详细的中文解读及忠实的英文译文。

每次解读都会结合问题说明签意，区分反思与预测，并针对健康、财务、法律及其他重大议题提供切实可行的七日行动建议和明确边界。用户还可选择为抽中的确切签号保存 JPEG 签卡。服务仅处理生成解读所需的输入，不会保存仪式会话。

Explore SiriusXM airplay tracked by xmplaylist. Find where a song played, discover new station additions, see a station’s most-played tracks, and compare changes in support for songs and artists. Read a briefing for your saved artist roster, then explore an individual artist’s songs, stations, and trends.

Results link back to xmplaylist reports and explain the selected time period and available coverage. With an explicit request, prepare a CSV export and receive its download link by email. You can also check your latest export’s status from chat.

Requires an xmplaylist account with API access. Requests share your plan’s daily API allowance. Recorded airplay may be incomplete; first detection is not a song’s release date. xmplaylist is not an official SiriusXM product.
payload.longDescription:
探索 xmplaylist 跟踪的 SiriusXM 播放记录。查找歌曲在哪些地方播放、发现新加入电台的歌曲、查看电台播放次数最多的曲目，并比较歌曲和艺人获得的支持变化。查看已保存艺人名单的简报，再深入了解单个艺人的歌曲、电台和趋势。

结果会链接回 xmplaylist 报告，并说明所选时间段和可用覆盖范围。经你明确请求后，可准备 CSV 导出文件，并通过电子邮件发送下载链接。你也可以在聊天中查看最近一次导出的状态。

需要拥有 API 访问权限的 xmplaylist 账号。请求会占用你套餐的每日 API 配额。已记录的播放情况可能不完整；首次检测日期并不代表歌曲发行日期。xmplaylist 不是 SiriusXM 官方产品。

payload.description: 塔罗出生牌与爱情配对

• What your card says about love, career and money, with advice, each linked to the full text on theastroscope.com

payload.name: Slide15

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Slide15 is a sliding-tile puzzle you can play without leaving ChatGPT. Ask for a puzzle and a board appears in the conversation: swipe, tap or use the arrow keys to slide the numbered tiles until they read in order.
